text:
Jules (People Ops): dropping a tiny Stop / Start / Continue kit for self-reviews and manager notes. 3 lines each, helps people be concise.

Jules (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW SS C (pasteable)
- Stop: One thing to stop doing that wastes time (1 line).
- Start: One new habit/skill you will start next cycle (1 line).
- Continue: One thing that worked and you will continue (1 line).

Anya (Eng Manager): i like this. can you add a one-line SMART rephrase for goals?

Jules (People Ops): SMART GOAL REPHRASE (one line)
- Original: "Improve infra reliability."
- SMART: "Reduce production incident rate by 30% by EoQ by adding health checks and rollback playbook (Owner: SRE)."

Ravi (IC): also add a tiny block to surface hiring priority in reviews (we keep forgetting).

Jules (People Ops): HIRING LINE (one line)
- "Hiring ask (priority: high/med/low): 1 <role> because <short rationale & impact>."

Sasha (Recruiter): perfect. can you make a manager starter phrase for 1:1s?

Jules (People Ops): MANAGER 1:1 START (one sentence)
- "Quick check: two wins this cycle, one blocker, and one thing I can do to help next sprint."

Anya (Eng Manager): adding to my recurring invites now. thanks! :thumbsup:

Jules (People Ops): pinned in #people-ops-templates and put a tiny Notion copy for edit. ping me if you want role-specific examples (PM/SRE/ML).
